div.l: Than the ꝑperson gat in monthes tweye .
And thus with feyned . flateryng ⁊and iapes .
He made the ꝑperson . ⁊and the peple his apes .
But trewly to tellen . at the laste .
He was in chirche . a noble ecclesiaste .
Well couthe he rede . a lesson or a storye .
But altherbest . he song an offertorye .
For well he wiste . whan that song was songe .
He muste preche . ⁊and well affile his tonge
To wynne siluer . as he well coude .
Ther fore he song so merily ⁊and loude
NOw haue I tolde yow . sothly in a clause
The estate the arraye . the nombre ⁊and eke the cause .
Whi that assembled was . this companye .
In southwerk . at this gentill hostelrye
That highte the Tabbarde . fast bi the belle .
But now is tyme . to you for to telle .
How that we baren vs . that ilke nyght .
Whan we weren . in that hostelrye a light . /
Andd after woll I tellen . of oure viage
And all the remenaūnt . of oure pilgrymage .
But first I praie yow . of your curtesie .
That ye ne rette it . nought my vilenye .
Though that I pleynly . speke in this matere .
To tellen you here wordis . ⁊and here chere .
Ne though I speke . her wordis proꝑperly .
For this ye knowen . as well as . I .
Who so schall telle . a tale after a man .
He moot reherse . as nygh as euer he can .
Eủerye worde . yf it be in his charge .
All speke he neuyr . so rudely or large .
Or elles he moot telle . his tale vntrewe .
Or feyne thyngis . or fynde wordis newe .
He may not spare . all though he were his brother .
He most as well saye . oo worde as another / .
Crist spak hym self . full brode in holi writ .
And well ye wote . no vilenye is it .
Eke Plato saieth . who so can hym rede .
The wordis . moot be cosyn to the dede .
Also I praie you . foryeue it me .
All haue I nought . sett folke in here degre
Here in this tale . as thei schulde stonde .
My wyt is schort . ye maie well vndirstonde .
GRet chere made oure hoost . vs eủerychon
And to the souper / . set he vs a non .
He ʆserued vs . with vitailes at the beste .
Stronge was the wyn . ⁊and well to drynke vs leste .
